_comment: Controlled-vocabulary mapping for morphological pit descriptors (cols 6-11 of morph_*.csv). Used by scripts/v6/morph_features.py. DO NOT hand-edit outputs — edit this file and regenerate. Version: V6-morph-vocab-1.0.

moisture_levels._comment: Ordered from dry (1) to saturated (6). Used to find depth_to_moist_cm (first layer >= level 3).

moisture_threshold_for_depth._comment: depth_to_moist_cm = top depth of first layer with moisture_level >= this value.
moisture_threshold_for_depth.label: fresh_or_wetter

hcl_effervescence._comment: Maps Вскипание от HCl text to ordered class: surface=2, weak=1, none=0, missing=null.

salt_tokens_in_inclusions._comment: Any of these substrings in col10 (Наличие включений) mark a salt-bearing layer. Used for depth_to_salt_cm. Deliberately EXCLUDES carb-only tokens (карбон/карбонаты) to avoid conflating carbonates with soluble salts.
salt_tokens_in_inclusions._note_exclude: карбонаты и соли is excluded because it is a mixed phrase where salt presence is ambiguous quantity-wise — the carb-only rows dominate. depth_to_salt is sourced from unambiguous salt mentions.

shell_tokens_in_inclusions._comment: Any of these substrings in col10 mark marine shell presence (marine_shell_flag).

rust_tokens_in_color._comment: Substrings in col7 (Цвет почвы) that indicate rust mottling — redox evidence of seasonal waterlogging. Used for rust_mottling_flag (any layer in pit).

gley_tokens_in_color._comment: Substrings in col7 indicating gleying (reductive grey-blue colours).

gley_suffix_in_horizon._comment: Substring in col6 (Индекс горизонта) indicating gley horizon suffix.

salic_suffix_in_horizon._comment: Horizon suffix codes for salic horizon (соленосный). зс = zasolen (salic), сн = solonetsy.

crust_tokens_in_structure._comment: Substrings in col8 (Структура и сложение) for the top layer that indicate a surface crust (корка). Used for surface_crust_flag.

feature_coverage_notes.depth_to_moist_cm: 73% coverage (56/76 pits); remainder have only dry or missing moisture — treated as NaN, NOT imputed.
feature_coverage_notes.depth_to_salt_cm: 59% coverage (45/76 pits); remainder have no salt mention in inclusions — treated as NaN, NOT imputed. Coverage <60%: missingness caveat required.
feature_coverage_notes.rust_mottling_flag: 56% coverage (43/76 pits have rust mention); 0 = none in profile, 1 = rust in any layer. Coverage <60%: missingness caveat required.
feature_coverage_notes.gley_flag: Derived from color (siz*) and horizon suffix (g); 56% co-occurring with rust. Reports presence in any layer.
feature_coverage_notes.solum_depth_cm: 100% coverage — max bottom depth per pit.
feature_coverage_notes.hcl_effervescence_class: ~96% non-null (HCl recorded for nearly all pits).
feature_coverage_notes.surface_crust_flag: High coverage; top layer structure recorded for most pits.
feature_coverage_notes.marine_shell_flag: 14% coverage (11/76 pits); low coverage — presence-only flag, absence is not confirmed absence.
feature_coverage_notes.horizon_salic_flag: 100% derivable (horizon codes present for all layers).
feature_coverage_notes.horizon_ploughed_flag: 100% derivable (horizon codes present for all layers).
